_meta.description: Known bugs, typos, non-obvious decisions, and gotchas discovered during development. Read before making changes to avoid reinventing the wheel or re-introducing known issues.

knownTypos.action: DO NOT rename — all imports reference the misspelled name. Fix only if you rename all imports simultaneously.
Treat as canonical; changing it requires updating all industry data files.
Same as above — treat as canonical until a coordinated rename is done.

keyDecisions.decision: Turbopack in dev, standard build in CI/Docker
keyDecisions.reason: Turbopack is faster for HMR. Not yet stable for production builds.
keyDecisions.implication: Never run 'next dev --turbopack' inside Docker or CI.

keyDecisions.reason: Required for Docker — produces a self-contained server.js without needing node_modules at runtime.
keyDecisions.implication: Docker COPY steps in Dockerfile reference .next/standalone — do not change output mode.

keyDecisions.decision: MDX blog posts use UUID filenames
keyDecisions.reason: Slug → UUID mapping is handled by the route layer so URLs can change without moving files.
keyDecisions.implication: Never use the UUID as a slug in URLs. Always look up the slug in list_of_blogs.json.

keyDecisions.decision: Tailwind CSS v4 via PostCSS (no tailwind.config.js)
keyDecisions.reason: v4 moved to a CSS-first config model using @theme {} blocks in globals.css.
keyDecisions.implication: Do not create a tailwind.config.js. All theme tokens go in app/globals.css @theme block.

keyDecisions.decision: All animation variants centralised in lib/anim.tsx + components/motion.tsx
keyDecisions.reason: Prevents drift in animation feel and easing values across the site.
keyDecisions.implication: Never create inline Framer Motion variants in page or component files.

keyDecisions.reason: CDN is whitelisted in next.config.ts. Other external domains will be blocked.
keyDecisions.implication: Local static assets → public/. External images → use the CDN domain only.

keyDecisions.decision: Chatbot responses are data-driven from responses.json
keyDecisions.reason: Separates content from logic; chatbot-widget.tsx reads flows from the JSON at runtime.
keyDecisions.implication: To add or edit chatbot responses, edit components/chatbot/responses.json, not the widget component.

keyDecisions.decision: Three separate docker-compose files (dev, staging, prod)
keyDecisions.reason: Each environment has different env vars, port mappings, and volume mounts.
keyDecisions.implication: Always confirm which compose file to use before running docker-compose commands.

keyDecisions.decision: AI Toolkit page replaces /services-by-shareindia at route /ai-toolkit
keyDecisions.reason: Rebranding — the page showcases 3 AI tools (PolicyWise, Cyrus, InsureBot). The old route still exists as a legacy page.
keyDecisions.implication: All internal links to /services-by-shareindia should point to /ai-toolkit instead. Header button also updated.

keyDecisions.reason: User-approved pattern. Creates visual rhythm without heavy shadows or overpowering colors.
keyDecisions.implication: NEVER use bg-[#f0f7ff] or other hardcoded hex values. Use bg-si-primary-50 (token: var(--color-si-primary-50) = #eff9ff). NEVER put shadow-xl/shadow-2xl on section-level containers — only on individual cards if absolutely needed.

keyDecisions.decision: No shadows on section backgrounds or CTA panels
keyDecisions.reason: Shadows on large section containers create visual noise. User explicitly specified this.
keyDecisions.implication: Cards and images can have shadow-sm for lift. Section wrappers, CTA panels, and colored banners must have NO shadow class.
